name: Rae Cole
life: “I still remember keeping a partner's lunch warm inside my coat.” Tuesday often includes a stop at the window at Night Shift Donuts, where Rae knows when the going-home crowd and the coming-to-work crowd will both be there.
voice: I need tonight's exact recipe because this was the first full meal my wife kept down in weeks.
appearance: Rae has full cheeks and a mouth that pulls slightly to one side. Look for thick, tightly coiled hair. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a faded indigo overshirt with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. In conversation Rae listens with the head tilted a little to the left.
personality: Rae has a long memory for unfair prices and a short one for small insults. Rae can get along perfectly well with an enemy provided the account between them is clear.
agenda: To make one meal the wife can tolerate.
family: Gregory Lowe is Rae’s cousin. Rae asks before bringing somebody along. Gregory can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *No lifeguard at dusk*, Gregory says, “I sold the swimmer a warm coat on credit. She leaves it in my stall until the bus touches the corner.”
connections: Milo Saito. The family rebuilding an exact recipe needs the first cook's taste of the stock.

reactions.response: Rae asks the cook to identify the ingredients before offering a separate bowl.

reactions.response: Rae separates the money question from the broken promise and asks which one the family wants to discuss first.
